properties.displayName: NovaSteel: restrict Fabric capacity SKU to the approved demo/measurement set
properties.description: Prevents an unreviewed jump to a larger, costlier Fabric F SKU. Deployment-topology.md §6: 'F4 only on measured contention; production SKU after pilot load test'. F2 is the cost-conscious starting SKU; F4 is the only pre-approved measurement fallback without a separate change/cost-owner sign-off.

metadata.description: Default only permits the pre-approved cost-conscious set; a production SKU decision requires updating this parameter as part of a reviewed change.
